sloka: नेयमस्ति पुरी लङ्का न यूयं न च रावणः ।यस्मादिक्ष्वाकुनाथेन बद्धं वैरं महात्मना ।। ५.४३.२५।।
transliteration: neyamasti purī laṅkā na yūyaṁ na ca rāvaṇaḥ ।yasmādikṣvākunāthena baddhaṁ vairaṁ mahātmanā ।। 5.43.25।।

translations.english: "Sugriva will come here with hundreds of thousands of crores of vanaras who would be fighting with their teeth and nails as weapons.
